summary: Replace the broad default FedEx MCP executor and Cobra mirror with eight reviewed shipping tools.
reason: A generic endpoint selector and runtime command mirror cannot be constrained by a Hermes tool allowlist and exposed unrelated file, SQL, import/export, webhook, bulk, and tracking-daemon capabilities.
validated_outcome: Unit and MCP protocol tests assert the exact eight-tool surface and operation-specific read-only, destructive, idempotent, and open-world annotations; fedex_execute and broad CLI mirror tools are absent, metadata matches runtime registration, non-FedEx remote API origins are rejected before credentials can be sent, and mutation results expose only action-specific allowlisted identifiers without labels, URLs, or address/contact fields.
